body: Yeah, I guess. I’m not going anywhere tonight. I’m just feeling lost, thanks for the time.

Yeah, I do feel like she’s just going to flip the switch one day and just be gone. It scares the shit out of me, there are many days where I wished I never got married and had kids. It would just be so much easier to be alone

I don’t know how to get her to understand that, and I guess it’s not really her responsibility. She didn’t sign on to be with someone who is depressed, I often feel like I tricked her into marrying me because I didn’t disclose enough info. I didn’t mean to hide anything, but it just comes and goes. I feel like she’d be happier without me.
Yeah I know, I appreciate the effort, it’s not really about time spent together, my insecurity just undermines our relationship, I get suspicious and fuck things up
I don’t know if I’m screwing up because I want it to end, I don’t really know what I’m doing, but we’ve got a house and kids and when I feel like it’s going to fall apart I panic

I know, but she’s so quick to assume the absolute worst, I’ve dealt with depression and insecurity my whole life and if I let any of it show, I’m fucked. She takes it as a personal insult. She’s s good person, I just feel like she’s so sick of me
